name: Forgiveness
overview: Scripture reveals forgiveness as a gracious act rooted in God's mercy and modeled in human relationships, exemplified by Esau’s warm embrace of Jacob after reconciliation and Joseph’s refusal to assume God’s judgment over his brothers despite their betrayal. Forgiveness extends even toward enemies, as shown in commands to aid those who hate us, highlighting a divine call to release resentment and restore relationships without denying offenses or ignoring justice. These narratives and instructions underscore forgiveness as a transformative, unilateral choice that reflects God’s abundant grace and calls believers to embody that same mercy in their spiritual lives.
